- **Boundary:** Markup attributes
  - **What to validate:** keyboard activation (Enter keydown, Space keyup) and a button click's focus
  - **How (stack-specific):** Since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness, in every document — the browser app's remote pages included — a pressed `Enter` whose target is the focused node, after the text-input and range arms, dispatches a Click on it when it is no disabled form control (`ElementData::is_disabled`, the `disabled` row; ratified by the founder (2026-10-18)) and is a `button`, a `summary`, an `input` of type `submit`, `reset` or `button`, or an `a` with `href` (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:120-125; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:257-272); a released Space on the focused node dispatches the same Click through the new `handle_key_up`, KeyUp's first default action, for a `button`, a `summary`, or an `input` of type `submit`, `reset`, `button`, `checkbox` or `radio` that is not disabled — a `disabled` attribute on a `summary` or an `a` gating neither key, a link taking no Space, and a text input and a range input taking neither key there (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/mod.rs:229-230; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:130-150; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:274-288); the Click's data is `Node::synthetic_click_event_data(modifiers)` and the event driver queues it, so the app's handlers run and then the default action `handle_click`, as for a pointer click — so Enter and Space now reach form submission, link navigation and `summary` toggling (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:290-300);
 `handle_click`'s submit arm became a button arm: a `button` of any type or an `input` of type `submit`, `reset` or `button` is focused through `generate_focus_events` / `set_focus_to`, its form owner submitted when it is a submit button, the walk ended matched, a disabled form control still stopping the walk first, a `disabled` attribute on any other element not, a click on a `select` focusing it (the `select` row), a click on a `multiple` select's row reaching `click_select_row` through an `option` arm (the `select` with `multiple` row), a checkbox's and a radio's arms sending `change` after `input` (the engine's `change` row) and a click on any other element unchanged (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:938-950; the focus and submit in the private `click_button` since 2026-10-16-handler-splits-and-readme, packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:1056-1073); the gates are a closed element-name and type match and `ElementData::is_disabled`, the presence check on a form control (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:260; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:277; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:760), with no print, log site, env read, `unwrap`, `expect` or panic in the added engine lines (the census probes read 0); no carrier, verb, key name (`KEY_NAMES` unchanged), field, log field or span is added — an engine change for every document and a boundary widening, ratified by the founder: his answers to the chunk's forks of 2026-10-13 «Клавиши нажимают (Рекомендую)» and «Клик даёт фокус (Рекомендую)», and his confirm of the wrap's answer card on 2026-10-14 «Подтвердить (Рекомендую)» — each by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer as his chosen option label, the English wording the overseer's — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness/report.md

- **Boundary:** Markup attributes
  - **What to validate:** the engine's `change` on a checkbox and a radio
  - **How (stack-specific):** In every document, remote pages included: `handle_click`'s checkbox and radio arms send, after `input`, a `DomEventData::Change` with the same value, the value class `input` carries — a checkbox always, a radio only where it was not checked before the click; `blitz-vibey-script`'s runtime synthesizes no `change`, so a page's script hears one `change`, from the engine; no carrier, verb, argument, key name, result field, cause, session error, exit, log field or span added; pinned by `checkable_change_event` 3 (a click and a Space on a checkbox each fire `input` then `change`), `text_range_no_change_event` 2 and `blitz-vibey-script`'s `radio_click_fires_change_only_where_it_was_not_checked` — an engine change for every document and a boundary widening, ratified (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:793-799; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:811; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:827-836) — as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-31-engine-debts/report.md

- **Boundary:** Markup attributes
  - **What to validate:** `select` with `multiple` — its keys and clicks
  - **How (stack-specific):** In every document, remote pages included: a closed key match, `press_multiple_select_key`: ArrowDown · ArrowUp · Home · End alone choose that row alone, with Shift span from the anchor (with no cursor yet, from the last chosen row), with Ctrl or Meta move the current row and change nothing; a Space with no typed text standing flips the current row and with text standing joins it; a character with no Ctrl, Alt or Meta chooses its match alone; Ctrl+A is not modelled; a click on a row, `click_select_row` behind `handle_click`'s `option` arm: a disabled select stops it, it focuses the select and clears the typeahead and text selection, plain chooses the row alone, Ctrl or Meta flips it, Shift spans, a disabled row changes nothing; disabled rows are never chosen and every choice passes `apply_select_choice`, the one write path, taking a set; the added lines hold no log site, print, env read or panic path, and no carrier, verb, argument, key name, result field, cause, session error, exit, log field or span is added; pinned by `select_interaction` and `stand_act_select`, counted at the `select` row — an engine change for every document and a boundary widening, ratified (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:213-244; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:351-380; packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:1013-1054) — as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-31-engine-debts/report.md

  - **How (stack-specific):** In every document, remote pages included: read by a closed element-name match: `options` walks a select's `option` children and its `optgroup` children's, in tree order, `is_select_option` holding under a group; `owner_select` and `option_disabled`, the one rule `readings` and form submission share (packages/blitz-dom/src/form.rs:281); `maybe_record_node`'s `optgroup` arm records its select; a group takes `Role::Group` and its non-empty `label` is its name in the tree, unpainted, inside the ratified name crossing; pinned by `select_interaction`, `stand_act_select` and `form`'s tests — an engine change for every document and a boundary widening, ratified as to the list through a group and not as to the `label` as a name (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/select.rs:125-129; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/select.rs:175-190; packages/blitz-dom/src/mutator.rs:1253-1257) — as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-31-engine-debts/report.md

subject: input
text:
- **Boundary:** Markup attributes
  - **What to validate:** password and file `input` value (the snapshot's `value`)
  - **How (stack-specific):** Masked by the in-process reader: under dioxus-native-dom's `accessibility` feature `DioxusDocument::snapshot` reads `NodeState::value` for an `input` whose `type` is `password` or `file` (each compared ASCII-case-insensitively) as the public constant `MASKED_VALUE` — eight U+2022 characters, one fixed marker whatever was typed or chosen — where the control holds a non-empty value (a password's editor text, else its `value` attribute; a file input's `value` attribute — it holds no text editor), as `""` where that value is empty and as `None` where a file input has no `value` attribute; never the text, never its length and never a file's host path. The typed text and the path occur in no id, name or value of any snapshot node, and the typed text in no label or value of any accessibility-tree node.
 Password- and file-only, and — but for the password's paint, below — snapshot-only: every other element's `value` reads as before, and the DOM is untouched — a file input's `value` attribute still holds the chosen file's host path and form submission still carries it (§Data Protection); the mask adds no input class and no crossing — the snapshot's one text form, `Snapshot::to_text`, reads the model, so its `value=` field holds the quoted `MASKED_VALUE` and neither literal occurs anywhere in the text, which reaches no log or event and a file only as a kept check's kept answer (since 2026-10-19-recorded-check-replay), where the mask holds — a value in it reads `MASKED_VALUE`, as on every carrier, beside the `type` stand-in `MASKED_STAND_IN` (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-07 and 2026-10-19, as the `id` row records); a diff of two snapshots (`Snapshot::diff`) takes its values from the snapshots only, so a password's or a file input's value in a diff entry is `MASKED_VALUE` — measured for a password input: the typed text occurs in no id, parent, name or value of any diff entry, the first character's entry reads `MASKED_VALUE` and further characters change no entry; a file input's by the same construction, not separately run — and the diff adds no input class and no crossing (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-07, as the `id` row records); since 2026-10-07-act-by-id the driver returns that text and that diff to the caller of `Session::run`, and the mask holds there — measured: a password typed through the driver's `type` occurs 0 times in what the call returns, written out whole, and the entry's value reads `MASKED_VALUE`, in both layout modes;
 since 2026-10-10-driver-cli control values cross the session socket and reach the client's stdout in a call's answer (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-10, as the `id` row records), and since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface MCP tool results on the `mcp` role's stdout — the mask holding there by construction, a result's text being `Session::run`'s own output (a `snapshot` block measured equal, byte for byte, to `Session::run`'s screen text; since 2026-10-12-self-description a password typed through an MCP `type` measured too — the typed text 0 times in either tool result, the input reading `MASKED_VALUE` with role `PasswordInput` and a non-empty name, in both layout modes, `stand_mcp_masked` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_mcp_masked.rs:67-143); a file input's over MCP by the same construction, not separately run) — a password's or a file input's as `MASKED_VALUE` and every other control's as it reads — measured for a password: the typed text occurs 0 times in the answer's written form and the value reads the mask, in both layout modes (`stand_act_filled`, and a unit test of the node writer); a file input's written form by the same construction, not separately run (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:11-13; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:258-285; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot_text.rs:53; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot_state.rs:647-696; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_snapshot_text.rs:1-7; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot_diff.rs:108; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_diff.rs:1-12; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_diff.rs:1-13)
 — the password mask as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-snapshot-state-fidelity/report.md, the file mask and the text at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-compact-snapshot-serialization/report.md, the diff at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-change-tracking-and-diff/report.md, the driver-typed password at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-act-by-id/report.md; since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot the mask also holds on the screen's pixels: blitz-paint paints an `input` whose `type` reads `password` masked, a bullet per character laid out in the document's own fonts by blitz-dom's `BaseDocument::layout_as_text_input`, in every document and through every renderer that paints with blitz-paint, windowed included (`draw_masked_input_text`, packages/blitz-paint/src/render.rs:975-1049) — an engine change for every document, ratified by the founder (2026-10-12, «Движок маскирует», by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed verbatim by the overseer); measured: two values of one length paint byte-identical frames, focused or not, in both layout modes (`password_painted_masked`), and a password typed through the driver never leaves as pixels in a `screenshot` (`stand_act_screenshot`); unlike `MASKED_VALUE` the frame depends on the value's length, and a click inside a field holding a value places the caret by the bullets
 — `ClickTarget::TextInput`'s `password` flag (an `input` whose `type` reads `password`, ASCII case-insensitive) sends it to the private `click_password_input`, which lays out one U+2022 per character through `BaseDocument::layout_as_text_input`, scrolls that layout as paint scrolls it, finds the bullet under the point with parley's `Cursor::from_point` and moves the real editor to that character's byte offset (a click `move_to_byte`, a shift-click `extend_selection_to_byte`, two or more clicks `select_all`), so no width of the real characters reaches the caret, an overflowing value included, and where a click-placed caret paints in a shot says nothing of them; every other text input keeps `move_to_point`; the snapshot, the diff and the frame's bullets stay masked as above, and nothing new crosses (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18) (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:585-651; tests/blitz-tests/tests/password_caret_click.rs:83-121); a file input's paint is unchanged — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-headless-screenshot/report.md; since 2026-10-19-session-recording a recorded `type` whose element resolves to a masked control — `dioxus_native_dom::is_masked_input`, now public, the test the snapshot's `value` reader calls, no reading changed — or to none (refused `stale` or `not-found`) is kept in the check as `MASKED_STAND_IN` (`"masked"`) with `masked:true`, never the text, its length or a digest of it, while any other `type`'s text, one refused by `validate` included, is kept as it crossed (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-19: F1 A · F2 B); measured: 0 sentinel occurrences, and a secret of another length leaves byte-identical files (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:233-240; packages/escher-driver/src/execute.rs:402-404; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_session_recording.rs:213-266)

  - **What to validate:** a clipping box's visible region (`BaseDocument::visible_region`)
  - **How (stack-specific):** On every document, remote pages included: `visible_region` reads each clipping box through its transforms, by the private `padding_box_in_view` over `transformed_bounds`; with no transform on the chain it reads the padding box in the client rect's frame, and a mapped box with a non-finite edge answers `None`; exact under a translate and a scale, under a rotation it reads the rotated padding box's bounding box, so it holds corners the box does not show; its callers are `execute.rs` `in_view` and `crop` and `lint.rs` `clip_region`; the added lines hold no log site, print, env read or panic path; pinned by `visible_region_transformed` 6, `stand_act_transformed` 3 and `transformed_client_rect` — an engine change for every document, ratified (packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:790-812; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:2574-2578) — as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-31-engine-debts/report.md
